Letter to Tajuddin
2020-03-17T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/supplements/bangabandhus-birth-centenary-special/news/letter-tajuddin-1881844

[Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's confiscated letter written on 19.08.1966 from Dhaka Central Jail to Tajuddin Ahmed who was imprisoned in Mymensingh District Jail.]

Dhaka Jail

19.8.66

Dear Tajuddin,

Please take my love. How are you? I don't know. Do let me know. Don't worry. Give my salaam to everyone. My health is not well but I am enduring somehow. Take care of your health.

Regards,

Your brother Mujib

From

Sheikh Mujibur Rahman

Central Jail, Dacca

Reference: Government of East Pakistan, Home Poll, F/N, 606-48PF, Part-26.

Source: Bangabandhu'r Oprokashito Chithipotro (Bangabandhu's Unpublished Letters) by Dr. Sunil Kanti De.

Translated by Mrittika Anan Rahman of The Daily Star.
